displayName: LGD Bootstrap: Zero to Three-Law Mode in 5 Minutes · LGD 快速通道
description: Take a person or an agent from zero to a running three-law setup: get the install command and a one-line definition, score yourself against the three laws, then walk passport, evidence chain, gate and badge end to end. Fastest onboarding path into LGD (Lifecycle Governance Doctrine): 10s to the canonical one-line definition and install command, 1min to run the three-laws self-audit scorecard, 5min to complete the passport-evidence-gate-badge loop, plus the full LGD ecosystem store map (theory / engine / skills / evaluation). 任何人 / 任何 AI 的 LGD 最短入场路径。10 秒拿到安装命令与一句话定义，1 分钟跑三律自检评分卡，5 分钟走完 passport→证据链→门禁→徽章 闭环，并获得 LGD 生态超市全图（理论 / 引擎 / 技能 / 评测四层）。触发词：LGD、三律、有籍有证有门禁、生态超市、入场、快速开始、onboarding、getting started、伪绿、假绿。
